newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Algeria gets $362 million loans from African bank.
newsitem.headline: Algeria gets $362 million loans from African bank.

text.p: The African Development Bank said it had approved two loans totalling $362 million for Algeria to finance a credit line and structural adjustment programmes.
The bank's board of governors on Wednesday approved a $145 loan for Credit Populaire d'Algerie to finance its line of credit, a bank statement said.
It signed the structural adjustment loan of $217 million for 14 years, with a grace of four years and at varied variable interest.

The credit line is meant to finance the foreign exchange component of projects for the development of small and medium-scale industries and services in the North African country over a three-year period.
